newsitem.title: CHINA: China opens tender for Beijing waterworks project.
newsitem.headline: China opens tender for Beijing waterworks project.

text.p: The China National Machinery Import and Export Corp announced a tender on Wednesday for the supply of finished water piping, butterfly valves, and exhaust valves to a Beijing water project.
The equipment would be used in a $140 million expansion of Beijing's Number Nine Water Works, a company official said.

The tender was issued in accordance with loan agreements between the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation and the Overseas Economic Cooperation Fund of Japan, the company said in an advertisment published in the China Daily.
Bids would be accepted from August 13 to 20, it said but gave no further details of the equipment required or financing available.
